answer: Value-scaled approval quorums resist fake identities. Transfers over 100 tokens need co-signatures: 2 of 3 for small transfers, 5 of 7 over 10,000. Each signer stakes 5,000 tokens aged 90 days and stays slashable a week. The signer set rotates each dawn by randomness, so no quorum is pre-bribed. Faking a 10,000-token transfer takes seven 90-day identities and 35,000 tokens locked three months, then the set reshuffles. A willow bends in small wind and stands in storms: tiny trades pass, big money needs rooted backing, and sybil farms chew umber dust for returns that never cover the stake.
